source: 变电站将110千伏电压降压为10千伏后配送给用户。
target: The substation steps up the voltage from 110 kV to 10 kV before distributing it to users.
error_info: 将“降压”错译为step up（升压），应为step down。

source: 风力发电机组在风速超过切出风速时自动停机。
target: The wind turbine automatically starts when the wind speed exceeds the cut-out speed.
error_info: 将“停机”错译为starts（启动），应为shuts down。

source: 输油管道每天向炼油厂输送原油约10万吨。
target: The pipeline delivers about 100,000 tons of gasoline to the refinery every day.
error_info: 将“原油”错译为gasoline（汽油），应为crude oil。

source: 关闭阀门后，管段内的天然气被安全放空。
target: After opening the valve, the natural gas in the pipe section is safely vented.
error_info: 将“关闭（阀门）”错译为opening（打开），应为closing。

source: 光伏组件将太阳能转化为直流电。
target: PV modules convert solar energy into alternating current.
error_info: 将“直流电”错译为alternating current（交流电），应为direct current。

source: 核反应堆在检测到异常时会自动紧急停堆。
target: Upon detecting an anomaly, the nuclear reactor automatically restarts.
error_info: 将“紧急停堆”错译为restarts（重启），应为scrams/shuts down。

source: 采煤工作面的瓦斯浓度超标时必须立即撤人。
target: When the gas concentration at the coal face is below the limit, all personnel must be evacuated immediately.
error_info: 将“超标”错译为below the limit（低于限值），应为exceeds the limit。

source: 调度中心下令将该线路由运行状态转为检修状态。
target: The dispatch center ordered the line to be switched from maintenance state to operational state.
error_info: 将状态转换方向译反：应为运行→检修，译文变为检修→运行。

source: 变压器油温超过85℃时冷却风扇自动启动。
target: When the transformer oil temperature exceeds 85°C, the cooling fans shut down automatically.
error_info: 将“（风扇）启动”错译为shut down（停止），应为start。

source: 检修人员进入受限空间前必须先进行气体检测。
target: Maintenance personnel must perform gas testing after entering the confined space.
error_info: 将“进入前”错译为after entering（进入后），时序错误。

source: 水电机组在用电高峰期承担调峰任务。
target: Hydropower units undertake peak-shaving tasks during off-peak periods.
error_info: 将“高峰期”错译为off-peak periods（低谷期），应为peak periods。

source: 天然气经加压站加压后通过长输管道外送。
target: After being depressurized at a compressor station, natural gas is exported through the long-distance pipeline.
error_info: 将“加压”错译为depressurized（减压），应为pressurized/compressed。

source: 风电机组的叶片可根据风速自动调整桨距角。
target: The blades of the wind turbine can automatically lock the pitch angle according to wind speed.
error_info: 将“调整（桨距角）”错译为lock（锁定），应为adjust。

source: 钻井平台发生井涌时应立即关闭防喷器。
target: In case of a kick on the drilling rig, the blowout preventer must be opened immediately.
error_info: 将“关闭防喷器”错译为opened（打开），井控处置方向相反，应为closed。

source: 储能电站在低谷时段充电、高峰时段放电。
target: The energy storage station discharges during off-peak hours and charges during peak hours.
error_info: 充放电时段被译反：应为低谷充电、高峰放电。

source: 输电线路覆冰厚度超过设计值时需进行融冰作业。
target: When the ice thickness on the transmission line is below the design value, de-icing operations are required.
error_info: 将“超过（设计值）”错译为below（低于），触发条件方向相反。

source: 炼油厂将原油分馏为汽油、柴油等产品。
target: The refinery mixes crude oil into products such as gasoline and diesel.
error_info: 将“分馏”错译为mixes（混合），应为fractionates。

source: 居民阶梯电价对超过第一档的用电量加价。
target: The residential tiered electricity price discounts the consumption exceeding the first tier.
error_info: 将“加价”错译为discounts（打折/降价），应为surcharges。

source: 该油田采用注水方式保持油层压力。
target: The oilfield uses water injection to deplete reservoir pressure.
error_info: 将“保持（油层压力）”错译为deplete（消耗），应为maintain。

source: 太阳能逆变器将直流电转换为交流电。
target: The solar inverter converts alternating current into direct current.
error_info: 电流转换方向译反：应为直流→交流，译文变为交流→直流。

source: 电缆沟内应保持清洁，严禁堆放杂物。
target: The cable trench should be kept clean, and debris is allowed to be piled inside.
error_info: 将“严禁”错译为allowed（允许），禁令含义完全相反。

source: 发生触电事故时应首先切断电源。
target: In an electric shock accident, the power supply should first be restored.
error_info: 将“切断（电源）”错译为restored（恢复送电），处置方向相反。

source: LNG接收站将液化天然气气化后输入管网。
target: The LNG terminal liquefies natural gas before feeding it into the pipeline network.
error_info: 将“气化”错译为liquefies（液化），应为regasifies/vaporizes。

source: 发电机组并网前须与电网同期。
target: The generating unit must be synchronized with the grid after it is connected to the grid.
error_info: 将“并网前”错译为after connected（并网后），时序错误。

source: 煤矿井下严禁使用非防爆电气设备。
target: Non-explosion-proof electrical equipment is permitted in underground coal mines.
error_info: 将“严禁使用”错译为permitted（允许使用），安全禁令被颠倒。

source: 燃气泄漏报警器安装在灶具上方。
target: The gas leak detector is installed below the stove.
error_info: 将“上方”错译为below（下方），安装位置错误。

source: 特高压输电可显著降低远距离输电损耗。
target: UHV transmission can significantly increase long-distance transmission losses.
error_info: 将“降低（损耗）”错译为increase（增加），应为reduce。

source: 检修完成后应拆除临时接地线并恢复送电。
target: After maintenance is completed, temporary grounding wires should be installed before restoring power.
error_info: 将“拆除（临时接地线）”错译为installed（装设），应为removed。

source: 地热电站利用地下蒸汽驱动汽轮机发电。
target: The geothermal power plant uses underground steam to drive gas turbines to generate electricity.
error_info: 将“汽轮机”错译为gas turbines（燃气轮机），应为steam turbines。

source: 油库储罐区的防火堤用于拦截泄漏油品。
target: The fire dike in the tank farm is used to drain leaked oil directly into the river.
error_info: 将“拦截（泄漏油品）”错译为drain into the river（排入河流），环保含义完全错误。

source: 智能电表可远程采集用户的用电数据。
target: Smart meters can remotely delete users' electricity consumption data.
error_info: 将“采集（数据）”错译为delete（删除），应为collect。

source: 风电机组的偏航系统使叶轮始终对准风向。
target: The yaw system of the wind turbine turns the rotor away from the wind at all times.
error_info: 将“对准风向”错译为turns away from the wind（背离风向），应为into the wind。

source: 油田伴生气被收集处理后用作燃料。
target: Associated gas in the oilfield is flared and wasted.
error_info: 将“收集处理后用作燃料”错译为flared and wasted（点燃放空浪费）。

source: 阴极保护装置可减缓埋地管道的腐蚀速度。
target: Cathodic protection devices accelerate the corrosion rate of buried pipelines.
error_info: 将“减缓（腐蚀）”错译为accelerate（加速），应为slow down。

source: 配电网采用中性点不接地方式运行。
target: The distribution network operates with its neutral point solidly grounded.
error_info: 将“中性点不接地”错译为solidly grounded（直接接地），系统接地方式被改变。

source: 光伏电站的支架需按照当地纬度调整倾角。
target: The supports of the PV plant must be tilted according to the local longitude.
error_info: 将“纬度”错译为longitude（经度），应为latitude。

source: 炼油装置停工检修前应对管线进行吹扫置换。
target: The pipelines should be purged and displaced after the refining unit is restarted.
error_info: 将“停工检修前”错译为after restarted（重启后），时序错误。

source: 发电用煤消耗量同比增长了5%。
target: Coal consumption for power generation decreased by 5% year on year.
error_info: 将“增长”错译为decreased（下降），方向相反。

source: 汽轮机冲转前应确认盘车装置已脱开。
target: Before the steam turbine starts rolling, confirm that the turning gear has been engaged.
error_info: 将“脱开”错译为engaged（啮合/投入），应为disengaged。

source: 微电网可在主网停电时切换为孤岛运行。
target: The microgrid can switch to grid-connected mode when the main grid loses power.
error_info: 将“孤岛运行”错译为grid-connected mode（并网模式），应为islanded mode。

source: 新建变电站将于今年年底前投入商业运行。
target: The newly built substation will be put into operation before the end of this year.
error_info: 漏译“商业”，商业运行的性质限定缺失。

source: 严禁在加油站范围内吸烟和使用明火。
target: Smoking is strictly prohibited within the gas station premises.
error_info: 漏译并列禁令“使用明火”。

source: 该输电线路全长120公里，共有铁塔320基。
target: The transmission line has a total length of 120 kilometers.
error_info: 漏译“共有铁塔320基”。

source: 风机在风速达到3米/秒的切入风速时开始发电。
target: The wind turbine starts generating when the wind speed reaches the cut-in speed.
error_info: 漏译切入风速数值“3米/秒的”。

source: 天然气长输管道沿途设置了15座截断阀室。
target: Block valve stations are installed along the long-distance natural gas pipeline.
error_info: 漏译阀室数量“15座”。

source: 检修工作必须办理工作票并得到值班调度许可。
target: Maintenance work must be authorized by the duty dispatcher.
error_info: 漏译强制前置手续“办理工作票”。

source: 核电厂周围设置了半径10公里的应急计划区。
target: An emergency planning zone is established around the nuclear power plant.
error_info: 漏译应急区范围“半径10公里的”。

source: 该水电站安装了4台单机容量25万千瓦的机组。
target: Four generating units are installed at the hydropower station.
error_info: 漏译单机容量参数“25万千瓦的”。

source: 进入生产现场必须佩戴安全帽并穿防静电工作服。
target: Safety helmets must be worn when entering the production site.
error_info: 漏译并列防护要求“穿防静电工作服”。

source: 油品装车时应静电接地，防止静电积聚引发爆炸。
target: Oil trucks should be electrostatically grounded during loading.
error_info: 漏译目的条款“防止静电积聚引发爆炸”。

source: 该煤矿设计年产能为300万吨，服务年限60年。
target: The coal mine has a designed annual capacity of 3 million tons.
error_info: 漏译矿井“服务年限60年”。

source: 配电网无功补偿可提高功率因数并降低线损。
target: Reactive power compensation in the distribution network can improve the power factor.
error_info: 漏译并列作用“降低线损”。

source: 液化天然气储罐采用双层壳结构以减少蒸发气。
target: LNG storage tanks adopt a double-shell structure.
error_info: 漏译设计目的“以减少蒸发气”。

source: 省调负责500千伏及以上电压等级设备的调度。
target: The provincial dispatch center is responsible for dispatching the equipment.
error_info: 漏译调度范围“500千伏及以上电压等级”。

source: 风电场升压站将机组出口电压升至220千伏送出。
target: The wind farm substation steps up the turbine output voltage for transmission.
error_info: 漏译送出电压等级“220千伏”。

source: 油气管线穿越河流处应加大管壁厚度并设置套管。
target: At river crossings, the wall thickness of oil and gas pipelines should be increased.
error_info: 漏译并列防护措施“设置套管”。

source: 用户申请新装电表须提供身份证明和房产证明。
target: Users applying for a new meter must provide identification.
error_info: 漏译必备材料“房产证明”。

source: 机组大修包括汽轮机检修、发电机检修和锅炉检验。
target: The major unit overhaul includes steam turbine maintenance and generator maintenance.
error_info: 漏译检修项目“锅炉检验”，三项只剩两项。

source: 该储能电站配置功率50兆瓦、容量100兆瓦时。
target: The energy storage station is configured with a power rating of 50 MW.
error_info: 漏译容量指标“100兆瓦时”。

source: 高瓦斯矿井必须建立瓦斯抽采系统和监测监控系统。
target: High-gas mines must establish a gas drainage system.
error_info: 漏译并列强制系统“监测监控系统”。

source: 炼油厂污水经处理达标后才可排入市政管网。
target: Refinery wastewater may be discharged into the municipal pipeline network after treatment.
error_info: 漏译关键条件“达标”，合规要求缺失。

source: 特高压直流输电适用于超过800公里的远距离送电。
target: UHV DC transmission is suitable for long-distance power transmission.
error_info: 漏译适用距离“超过800公里的”。

source: 检修人员应在工作地段两端装设接地线。
target: Maintenance personnel should install grounding wires.
error_info: 漏译装设位置“工作地段两端”。

source: 该气田探明天然气地质储量超过1000亿立方米。
target: The gas field has proven geological reserves of natural gas.
error_info: 漏译储量数值“超过1000亿立方米”。

source: 变电站继电保护装置包括差动保护和距离保护。
target: The substation relay protection includes differential protection.
error_info: 漏译保护类型“距离保护”。

source: 燃煤电厂烟气经脱硫、脱硝和除尘后达标排放。
target: Flue gas from coal-fired power plants is discharged after desulfurization and denitrification.
error_info: 漏译处理环节“除尘”。

source: 发生大面积停电时应优先恢复医院和通信枢纽供电。
target: During a widespread blackout, power supply to hospitals should be restored first.
error_info: 漏译优先恢复对象“通信枢纽”。

source: 钻井液用于冷却钻头、携带岩屑和平衡地层压力。
target: Drilling fluid is used to cool the drill bit and carry cuttings.
error_info: 漏译关键作用“平衡地层压力”，井控功能缺失。

source: 该省能源消费以煤炭为主，清洁能源占比不足20%。
target: The province's energy consumption is dominated by coal.
error_info: 漏译结构信息“清洁能源占比不足20%”。

source: 倒闸操作应由两人执行，一人操作、一人监护。
target: Switching operations shall be performed by two people.
error_info: 漏译职责分工“一人操作、一人监护”。

source: 风机塔筒高度为80米。
target: The turbine tower is 80 meters tall and painted white for aviation safety.
error_info: 增译原文没有的“涂成白色以保障航空安全”。

source: 该变电站安装两台主变压器。
target: The substation is equipped with two main transformers, each rated at 180 MVA.
error_info: 增译原文没有的参数“每台额定容量180兆伏安”。

source: 天然气的主要成分是甲烷。
target: Natural gas is mainly composed of methane and contains no sulfur at all.
error_info: 增译原文没有且不成立的“完全不含硫”。

source: 光伏电站设计寿命为25年。
target: The PV plant has a design life of 25 years, with guaranteed output for 30 years.
error_info: 增译原文没有的“质保出力30年”。

source: 油井经过压裂改造后产量明显提高。
target: After fracturing stimulation, well production increased significantly and doubled within one year.
error_info: 增译原文没有的“一年内翻倍”。

source: 核电站反应堆冷却剂采用轻水。
target: The reactor coolant is light water, circulated by four reactor coolant pumps.
error_info: 增译原文没有的设备配置“4台冷却剂泵”。

source: 该配电网电压等级为10千伏。
target: The distribution network operates at 10 kV with a total of 200 outgoing feeders.
error_info: 增译原文没有的“共200条出线”。

source: 加油站地下设有双层油罐。
target: Double-wall oil tanks are installed underground, each with a capacity of 50 cubic meters.
error_info: 增译原文没有的容量参数“每个50立方米”。

source: 储能系统参与电网调频。
target: The energy storage system participates in grid frequency regulation and can respond within 100 milliseconds.
error_info: 增译原文没有的响应时间“100毫秒内”。

source: 输电线路采用钢芯铝绞线。
target: The transmission line uses ACSR conductors with a cross-sectional area of 400 square millimeters.
error_info: 增译原文没有的截面参数“400平方毫米”。

source: 常减压装置是原油加工的第一道工序。
target: The atmospheric-vacuum distillation unit is the first crude processing unit, processing 10 million tons per year.
error_info: 增译原文没有的加工能力“每年1000万吨”。

source: 该风场共有66台风电机组。
target: The wind farm has 66 wind turbines, all manufactured domestically in China.
error_info: 增译原文没有的产地信息“全部国产”。

source: 智能电表支持远程拉合闸。
target: The smart meter supports remote disconnection and reconnection and automatic daily meter reading.
error_info: 增译原文没有的功能“每日自动抄表”。

source: 矿井提升机负责人员和物料的升降。
target: The mine hoist is responsible for lifting personnel and materials at a speed of 8 meters per second.
error_info: 增译原文没有的运行速度“每秒8米”。

source: LNG运输船在接收站码头卸载。
target: The LNG carrier unloads at the receiving terminal, and the entire operation takes about 24 hours.
error_info: 增译原文没有的作业耗时“约24小时”。

source: 燃气轮机以天然气为燃料。
target: The gas turbine runs on natural gas with a rated efficiency of 42 percent.
error_info: 增译原文没有的效率指标“42%”。

source: 光伏发电站配有无功补偿装置。
target: The PV plant is equipped with a reactive power compensation device, with land reserved for future expansion.
error_info: 增译原文没有的“预留扩建场地”。

source: 该水电站大坝为混凝土重力坝。
target: The hydropower dam is a concrete gravity dam standing 120 meters high.
error_info: 增译原文没有的坝高“120米”。

source: 采油树用于控制油井的生产。
target: The Christmas tree is used to control well production and is rated for a pressure of 10,000 psi.
error_info: 增译原文没有的额定压力“10000psi”。

source: 该电力变压器采用油浸自冷方式。
target: The power transformer uses oil-immersed natural-air cooling and weighs 80 tons.
error_info: 增译原文没有的重量参数“重80吨”。

source: 该光伏电站采用固定支架安装。
target: The PV plant is installed on fixed-tilt supports at a tilt angle of 35 degrees.
error_info: 增译原文没有的倾角参数“35度”。

source: 输气管道设计压力为10兆帕。
target: The gas pipeline has a design pressure of 10 MPa and a diameter of 1,016 millimeters.
error_info: 增译原文没有的管径参数“1016毫米”。

source: 核电厂设置柴油发电机作为应急电源。
target: The nuclear plant is equipped with diesel generators as emergency power, with enough fuel for seven days.
error_info: 增译原文没有的燃油储备“可供7天”。

source: 煤层气抽采可降低矿井瓦斯风险。
target: Coalbed methane drainage can reduce mine gas hazards and produce pipeline-quality methane.
error_info: 增译原文没有的产出结论“生产符合管输标准的甲烷”。

source: 变电站直流系统为控制和保护回路供电。
target: The substation DC system supplies the control and protection circuits using two sets of 220 V batteries.
error_info: 增译原文没有的配置“两组220伏蓄电池”。

source: 该机组可在无外部电源情况下实现黑启动。
target: This unit can achieve a black start only after receiving external power supply.
error_info: 将“无外部电源即可黑启动”歪曲为“必须有外部电源才能黑启动”，黑启动本质被否定。

source: 风电出力具有间歇性，需要配套调峰电源。
target: Wind power output is fully dispatchable and requires no supporting peak-shaving power sources.
error_info: 将“间歇性、需配套调峰”歪曲为“完全可调度、无需调峰”。

source: 检修完毕后，设备可恢复至备用状态。
target: After maintenance is completed, the equipment may be returned to a scrapped state.
error_info: 将“备用状态”歪曲为“报废状态”，处置性质完全不同。

source: 该项目实施“上大压小”，关停小机组、建设大机组。
target: This project replaces large units with smaller ones by shutting down large units and building small ones.
error_info: 将“上大压小（关停小的、建设大的）”歪曲为“关大建小”，政策方向完全相反。

source: 瓦斯浓度达到报警值时，监测系统发出声光报警。
target: When the gas concentration reaches the alarm value, the monitoring system only records it silently on the screen without any alarm.
error_info: 将“发出声光报警”歪曲为“仅静默记录、不报警”。

source: 抽水蓄能电站在用电低谷时抽水蓄能。
target: The pumped-storage station generates electricity during low-demand periods.
error_info: 将低谷时段“抽水蓄能”歪曲为“发电”，运行方式完全错误。

source: 计划停电需提前7天通知重要用户。
target: Planned outages only require notifying important users on the same day.
error_info: 将“提前7天通知”歪曲为“当天通知”，通知时限被改变。

source: 成品油管道采用顺序输送以减少混油段。
target: The product pipeline uses batch transportation, which increases the mixing section between products.
error_info: 将“减少混油段”歪曲为“增加混油段”，工艺作用被颠倒。

source: 该政策要求新建燃煤机组实现超低排放。
target: The policy requires newly built coal-fired units to operate without any emission control facilities.
error_info: 将“实现超低排放”歪曲为“无需任何治污设施”，政策要求被篡改。

source: 发生全厂断电事故时，应急堆芯冷却系统自动投入。
target: In the event of a station blackout, the emergency core cooling system remains manually disabled and cannot start.
error_info: 将“自动投入”歪曲为“人工禁用、无法启动”，安全功能被否定。

source: 光伏扶贫电站的收益用于帮扶贫困村。
target: The revenue of the PV poverty-alleviation plant is turned over to the provincial government.
error_info: 将收益用途“帮扶贫困村”歪曲为“上缴省级政府”。

source: 汽轮机跳闸后应立即检查大轴弯曲情况。
target: After a steam turbine trip, inspection of the shaft bending is prohibited for safety reasons.
error_info: 将“应立即检查”歪曲为“禁止检查”，处置要求相反。

source: 油气管网设施应当向第三方用户公平开放。
target: Oil and gas pipeline facilities must be reserved exclusively for the owner's own use.
error_info: 将“向第三方公平开放”歪曲为“只供业主自用”，开放义务被否定。

source: 该线路装设自动重合闸以提高供电可靠性。
target: Automatic reclosing is permanently disabled on this line to improve reliability.
error_info: 将“装设重合闸提高可靠性”歪曲为“永久停用重合闸”。

source: 高耗能企业执行差别电价，加价约束其用能。
target: Energy-intensive enterprises enjoy discounted preferential electricity prices.
error_info: 将差别电价中的惩罚性“加价”歪曲为“优惠折扣电价”。

source: 井下发生火灾时，人员应沿规定的避灾路线撤离。
target: In case of an underground fire, personnel should escape through the main conveyor roadway.
error_info: 将撤离路径“规定的避灾路线”歪曲为“主运输大巷”，逃生指引错误。

source: 海上风电机组的单机容量普遍大于陆上风电机组。
target: Offshore wind turbines generally have a smaller rated capacity than onshore turbines.
error_info: 将海上机组“容量更大”歪曲为“容量更小”，比较关系相反。

source: 液化天然气的体积约为同量气态天然气的1/600。
target: Liquefied natural gas occupies about 600 times more volume than the same amount of gaseous natural gas.
error_info: 将体积关系“约为气态的1/600”歪曲为“比气态大600倍”，数量关系完全相反。

source: 供电企业应对用户受电工程提供技术指导。
target: The power supply enterprise must fully fund and construct the customer's incoming power works.
error_info: 将“提供技术指导”歪曲为“全额出资并建设”，责任性质被改变。

source: 有载调压变压器可在带负荷运行中切换分接头。
target: On-load tap changers can only be switched after the transformer is completely shut down.
error_info: 将“可带负荷切换”歪曲为“必须完全停电后才能切换”，设备能力被否定。

source: 该炼油厂按计划将于明年停工大修。
target: The refinery will undergo an unplanned emergency shutdown for overhaul next year.
error_info: 将“按计划停工”歪曲为“非计划紧急停工”，停工性质被改变。

source: 放射性废物应按放射性水平分类处置。
target: All radioactive waste shall be disposed of together regardless of its radioactivity level.
error_info: 将“按放射性水平分类处置”歪曲为“不分类混合处置”。

source: 分布式光伏发电可就近消纳、减少线损。
target: Distributed PV generation requires long-distance transmission and increases line losses.
error_info: 将“就近消纳、减少线损”歪曲为“需远距离输送、增加线损”。

source: 海上钻井平台依靠直升机和补给船获得物资。
target: The offshore drilling rig is supplied with materials solely through a submarine pipeline.
error_info: 将补给方式“直升机和补给船”歪曲为“仅靠海底管道”。

source: 调度机构按照公平、公正、公开的原则安排并网。
target: The dispatch agency arranges grid connection based on a paid first-come-first-served priority principle.
error_info: 将并网原则“公平、公正、公开”歪曲为“付费优先、先到先得”。

source: 油田进入开发后期后，油井综合含水率普遍上升。
target: After an oilfield enters the late development stage, the overall water cut of its wells generally declines.
error_info: 将含水率“普遍上升”歪曲为“普遍下降”，变化趋势相反。

source: 该风电场弃风率已降至5%以下。
target: The wind curtailment rate of this wind farm has risen above 50 percent.
error_info: 将“弃风率降至5%以下”歪曲为“升至50%以上”。

source: 燃气加臭剂使天然气泄漏时容易被人察觉。
target: Gas odorant is added to improve the combustion efficiency of natural gas.
error_info: 将加臭目的“泄漏时易察觉”歪曲为“提高燃烧效率”。

source: 电网企业应按国家规定全额收购可再生能源上网电量。
target: Grid companies may refuse to purchase renewable energy power at their own discretion.
error_info: 将“应全额收购”歪曲为“可自行拒绝收购”，法定义务被否定。

source: 燃煤耦合生物质发电可减少化石能源消耗。
target: Co-firing biomass with coal increases fossil energy consumption.
error_info: 将“减少化石能源消耗”歪曲为“增加化石能源消耗”，作用方向相反。

source: 停电操作必须先拉开断路器，再拉开隔离开关。
target: For a power cut, first open the disconnectors, then open the circuit breakers.
error_info: 操作顺序颠倒：必须先断断路器、后拉隔离开关，颠倒会带负荷拉刀闸。

source: 故障线路切除后，重合闸装置先检定无压再合闸。
target: After the faulty line is cleared, the auto-reclosure first closes the breaker and then checks that the line is dead.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：应先检定线路无压、再合闸，译文变为先合闸后检定。

source: 因用电负荷创新高，全省实施了有序用电。
target: The electricity load hit a record high because the province implemented orderly power consumption.
error_info: 因果倒置：有序用电是负荷创新高的结果，译文倒因为果。

source: 锅炉点火前应先启动引风机对炉膛进行吹扫。
target: Ignite the boiler first, and then start the induced draft fan to purge the furnace.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：必须先通风吹扫、再点火，颠倒可能引发炉膛爆炸。

source: 线路差动保护动作后，线路两侧断路器同时跳开。
target: The breakers on both sides of the line tripped, causing the line differential protection to operate.
error_info: 因果倒置：是保护动作导致断路器跳闸，译文说成跳闸导致保护动作。

source: 水电机组应先并网，再开启导水叶增加负荷。
target: First open the wicket gates to increase load, and then synchronize the hydropower unit to the grid.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：应先同期并网、再开导叶带负荷。

source: 安全阀起跳，说明系统压力已经超过整定值。
target: The system pressure exceeded the set value because the safety valve lifted.
error_info: 因果倒置：超压导致安全阀起跳，译文倒因为果。

source: 调度指令须先经值班负责人审核，再下达执行。
target: Dispatch instructions are executed first, and then reviewed by the shift supervisor before release.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：应先审核、后下达执行，译文变为先执行后审核。

source: 变压器送电时应先合电源侧断路器。
target: When energizing a transformer, close the load-side circuit breaker first.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：应先合电源侧开关，译文变为先合负荷侧。

source: 因入库来水量减少，水电发电量同比下降。
target: Reservoir inflow decreased because hydropower generation fell year on year.
error_info: 因果倒置：来水减少导致发电量下降，译文倒因为果。

source: 继电保护先发出跳闸脉冲，断路器随后跳开。
target: The circuit breaker trips first, and the protection relay then sends the trip signal.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：应保护先动作发令、断路器后跳闸。

source: 开采被保护层之前，必须先开采保护层。
target: The protected coal seam must be mined first, followed by the protective seam.
error_info: 开采顺序颠倒：必须先采保护层卸压，再采被保护层。

source: 母线电压持续偏低时，变电站应投入并联电容器。
target: If the bus voltage stays low, the substation switches off the shunt capacitors.
error_info: 处置方向颠倒：低电压时应投入电容器无功补偿，译文变为切除电容器。

source: 原油先进入常压塔分馏，再进入减压塔。
target: Crude oil first enters the vacuum tower for fractionation, and then enters the atmospheric tower.
error_info: 流程顺序颠倒：应为常压塔在前、减压塔在后。

source: 由于午间风电大发，火电机组压减出力。
target: Wind power output surged at noon because the coal-fired units ramped down their output.
error_info: 因果倒置：风电大发是火电压减出力的原因，译文倒因为果。

source: 测量绝缘电阻前，必须先停电并充分放电。
target: Measure the insulation resistance first, and then de-energize the equipment and fully discharge it.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：必须先停电放电、再测绝缘，颠倒会带电测量危及人身。

source: 汽轮机升速时应快速越过临界转速区。
target: During run-up, the turbine should pass slowly through the critical speed range.
error_info: 操作要求颠倒：临界转速区必须快速通过，译文变为缓慢停留。

source: 事故处理后应先恢复供电，再补齐操作记录。
target: Complete the operation records first, and then restore power supply after the incident.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：应先恢复供电、后补记录，译文变为先补记录后送电。

source: 逆变器检测到电网失压后，应立即停止向电网送电。
target: The inverter detects the grid voltage loss only after it has stopped exporting power to the grid.
error_info: 时序颠倒：应先检测到失压、再停止送电（防孤岛），译文变为停止送电后才检测到。

source: 动火分析合格后，才能开具动火作业票。
target: The hot-work permit may be issued before the gas analysis results are qualified.
error_info: 条件顺序颠倒：应先分析合格、后开票，译文变为先开票后等结果。

source: 备用电源自动投入装置在工作电源断开后动作。
target: The automatic bus transfer device operates first, and then the working power supply is disconnected.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：应工作电源先断开、备自投后动作，译文动作时序相反。

source: 由于煤炭价格上涨，燃煤电厂利润受到挤压。
target: Coal prices rose because the profit margins of coal-fired power plants were squeezed.
error_info: 因果倒置：煤价上涨挤压电厂利润，译文倒因为果。

source: 闸门全开后，水电机组引用流量达到设计值。
target: The unit reaches the design water flow first, and then the gate is fully opened.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：应闸门先全开、流量后达到设计值。

source: 发现油管刺漏时，应先停泵再拆卸处理。
target: When a leaking oil pipe is found, dismantle it first, and then stop the pump.
error_info: 顺序颠倒：必须先停泵泄压、再拆卸，颠倒会造成带压拆卸伤人。

source: 给蓄电池充电时应先接正极、后接负极。
target: When charging a battery, connect the negative terminal first, and then the positive terminal.
error_info: 接线顺序颠倒：应为先接正极、后接负极。

source: 电流互感器二次回路严禁开路。
target: The secondary circuit of a current transformer must not be short-circuited.
error_info: 概念术语错误：CT二次严禁开路（open-circuited），译文错为短路（short-circuited）。

source: 无功补偿装置用于提高系统的功率因数。
target: The reactive power compensation device is used to improve the system's power coefficient.
error_info: 术语错误：功率因数应为power factor，power coefficient为功率系数（空气动力学等概念）。

source: 该变电站母线采用铝合金管型导体。
target: The mother line of this substation uses aluminum alloy tubular conductors.
error_info: 术语错误：母线应为busbar，mother line为中式直译。

source: 该汽轮机的额定进汽压力为16.7兆帕。
target: The rated inlet steam pressure of this steam machine is 16.7 MPa.
error_info: 术语错误：汽轮机应为steam turbine，steam machine为误译。

source: 光伏逆变器应具备低电压穿越能力。
target: The PV inversing device must have low-voltage ride-through capability.
error_info: 术语错误：逆变器应为inverter，inversing device为自造词。

source: 该风电场风机装机容量合计为500兆瓦。
target: The total assembled capacity of the wind turbines at this wind farm is 500 MW.
error_info: 术语错误：装机容量应为installed capacity，assembled capacity为误译。

source: 避雷器用于限制沿线路侵入的雷电过电压。
target: The lightning rod is used to limit lightning overvoltages intruding along the line.
error_info: 术语/器件错误：限制侵入波过电压的是避雷器surge arrester，lightning rod是避雷针（保护建筑物）。

source: 发电机励磁系统用于调节无功输出。
target: The magnetizing system of the generator is used to regulate reactive power output.
error_info: 术语错误：励磁系统应为excitation system，magnetizing为磁化。

source: 同期装置检查压差、频差和角差后允许并网。
target: The same-period device allows grid connection after checking voltage, frequency and angle differences.
error_info: 术语错误：同期装置应为synchronizing device，same-period为中式直译。

source: 该储能电站可提供黑启动服务。
target: This energy storage station can provide black beginning services.
error_info: 术语错误：黑启动应为black start，black beginning为自造说法。

source: 继电保护动作后应闭锁重合闸并发出告警。
target: After the relay insurance operates, it blocks reclosing and sends an alarm.
error_info: 术语错误：继电保护应为relay protection，relay insurance为误译。

source: 加油站对成品油库存实行每日盘点。
target: The gas station conducts daily inventory checks of its finished oil stock.
error_info: 术语错误：成品油应为refined products/product oil，finished oil为中式英语。

source: 抽油机通过往复运动将井底原油举升至地面。
target: The oil-pumping machine lifts crude oil from the bottom of the well to the surface through reciprocating motion.
error_info: 术语错误：抽油机标准术语为pumping unit（pumpjack），oil-pumping machine为中式直译。

source: 加氢站每天可为200辆氢燃料电池汽车加注。
target: The hydrogen-adding station can refuel 200 hydrogen fuel cell vehicles every day.
error_info: 术语错误：加氢站应为hydrogen refueling station，hydrogen-adding为中式直译。

source: 选煤厂负责原煤的洗选和加工。
target: The coal selecting plant is responsible for washing and processing raw coal.
error_info: 术语错误：选煤厂应为coal preparation plant，coal selecting为误译。

source: 充电桩通过CAN总线与车辆电池管理系统通信。
target: The charging pile communicates with the vehicle's battery management system over a CAN bus.
error_info: 术语错误：电动汽车充电桩应为EV charger/charging station，charging pile为中式直译。

source: 高压开关柜内配置了五防闭锁装置。
target: The high-voltage switch cabinet is equipped with five-prevention interlocks.
error_info: 术语错误：开关柜应为switchgear，switch cabinet为非标准说法。

source: 燃气轮机联合循环的发电效率可达60%以上。
target: The combined cycle of the gas engine can achieve a generation efficiency of over 60 percent.
error_info: 术语/设备错误：燃气轮机应为gas turbine，gas engine指燃气内燃机，是不同设备。

source: 绝缘子表面污闪可能导致线路跳闸。
target: Pollution flashover on the isolator surface may cause line tripping.
error_info: 术语错误：绝缘子应为insulator，isolator在电力系统中指隔离开关，器件被混淆。

source: 该电厂供电标准煤耗降至每千瓦时290克。
target: The standard coal cost for power supply at this plant fell to 290 grams per kWh.
error_info: 术语错误：煤耗（煤消耗量）应为coal consumption，coal cost意为煤炭成本。

source: 静电除尘器出口烟尘浓度低于10毫克每立方米。
target: The dust concentration at the outlet of the static dust remover is below 10 mg per cubic meter.
error_info: 术语错误：静电除尘器应为electrostatic precipitator（ESP），static dust remover为误译。

source: 压裂车组向井内注入高压液体以压开地层。
target: The pressing-crack truck fleet injects high-pressure fluid into the well to fracture the formation.
error_info: 术语错误：压裂应为hydraulic fracturing（fracking），pressing crack为中式直译。

source: 地下储气库用于季节性调峰和应急供气。
target: The underground gas warehouse is used for seasonal peak shaving and emergency gas supply.
error_info: 术语错误：储气库应为gas storage（facility），gas warehouse为中式直译。

source: 关口计量装置的准确度等级不低于0.2S级。
target: The accuracy class of the gateway measuring device shall be no lower than class 0.2S.
error_info: 术语错误：电力计量装置应为metering device，measering为一般测量。

source: 该油藏采用水平井和体积压裂进行开发。
target: The oil storage is developed using horizontal wells and volume fracturing.
error_info: 术语错误：油藏（油气储层）应为reservoir，oil storage指储油设施。

source: 偏航误差超过设定值时，机组自动对风。
target: When the deviation error exceeds the set value, the turbine automatically aligns itself with the wind.
error_info: 术语错误：风机偏航误差应为yaw error，deviation为一般偏差。

source: 特高压换流站实现交流电与直流电的相互转换。
target: The UHV current-changing station converts alternating current into direct current and vice versa.
error_info: 术语错误：换流站应为converter station，current-changing为中式自造说法。

source: 输电线路上装设了自动重合闸装置。
target: An automatic reclose-switch device is installed on the transmission line.
error_info: 术语错误：自动重合闸应为auto-reclosure（automatic reclosing），reclose-switch为自造词。

source: 分布式电源并网应配置防孤岛保护。
target: Grid-connected distributed generation shall be equipped with anti-isolated-island protection.
error_info: 术语错误：防孤岛保护应为anti-islanding protection，anti-isolated-island为误译。

source: 变电站直流系统采用220伏蓄电池组。
target: The substation direct-flow system uses 220 V battery banks.
error_info: 术语错误：直流系统应为DC (direct current) system，direct-flow为误译。

source: 该火电厂装机容量为2台660兆瓦机组。
target: This coal-fired power plant has an installed capacity of two 600 MW units.
error_info: 数字错误：单机容量660兆瓦被译成600兆瓦。

source: 该线路导线设计安全系数不小于2.5。
target: The design safety factor of the line conductors is no less than 5.2.
error_info: 数字错误：安全系数2.5被译成5.2。

source: 风机切入风速为3米/秒，切出风速为25米/秒。
target: The turbine cut-in wind speed is 3 m/s and the cut-out wind speed is 15 m/s.
error_info: 数字错误：切出风速25米/秒被译成15米/秒。

source: 标准情况下，1桶原油约等于159升。
target: Under standard conditions, one barrel of crude oil equals about 195 liters.
error_info: 数字错误：每桶159升被译成195升。

source: 该光伏电站等效年满负荷利用小时数为1100小时。
target: The equivalent annual full-load utilization hours of this PV plant are 110 hours.
error_info: 数字错误：利用小时数1100被译成110。

source: 主蒸汽温度应控制在540摄氏度。
target: The main steam temperature should be controlled at 450 degrees Celsius.
error_info: 数字错误：蒸汽温度540℃被译成450℃。

source: 该天然气热值约为每立方米36兆焦。
target: The calorific value of this natural gas is about 63 megajoules per cubic meter.
error_info: 数字错误：热值36兆焦被译成63兆焦。

source: 10千伏用户受电端的电压允许偏差为正负7%。
target: The allowable voltage deviation at the receiving end of 10 kV customers is plus or minus 17 percent.
error_info: 数字错误：允许偏差±7%被译成±17%。

source: 该核电机组的单机容量为175万千瓦。
target: The single-unit capacity of this nuclear power unit is 1.57 million kilowatts.
error_info: 数字错误：容量175万千瓦被译成157万千瓦。

source: 煤矿安全规程规定井下空气中氧气浓度不得低于20%。
target: Coal mine safety regulations require that the oxygen concentration in underground air be no lower than 12 percent.
error_info: 数字错误：氧气浓度下限20%被译成12%。

source: 该天然气长输管道全长8600公里。
target: The total length of this long-distance natural gas pipeline is 6,800 kilometers.
error_info: 数字错误：管道全长8600公里被译成6800公里。

source: 该风机塔筒共分三段，总高度为90米。
target: The turbine tower consists of five sections with a total height of 90 meters.
error_info: 数字错误：塔筒分段数三段被译成五段。

source: 该500千伏变电站安装了三台750兆伏安主变压器。
target: This 500 kV substation is equipped with three 570 MVA main transformers.
error_info: 数字错误：主变容量750兆伏安被译成570兆伏安。

source: 居民第一阶梯气量为每月300立方米。
target: The first tier for residential gas consumption is 3,000 cubic meters per month.
error_info: 数字错误：第一档气量300立方米被译成3000立方米。

source: 该探井钻至6500米深度后完钻。
target: The exploration well was completed at a drilled depth of 5,600 meters.
error_info: 数字错误：完钻井深6500米被译成5600米。

source: 该地区综合线损率应控制在4.5%以内。
target: The comprehensive line loss rate in this region should be kept within 5.4 percent.
error_info: 数字错误：线损率4.5%被译成5.4%。

source: 脱硫装置设计脱硫效率不低于95%。
target: The design desulfurization efficiency of the unit is no lower than 59 percent.
error_info: 数字错误：脱硫效率95%被译成59%。

source: 该水电站水库总库容为28亿立方米。
target: The total storage capacity of this hydropower reservoir is 280 million cubic meters.
error_info: 数字错误：总库容28亿立方米（2.8 billion）被译成2.8亿（280 million），相差十倍。

source: 光伏电站功率因数应在0.95超前至0.95滞后范围内。
target: The power factor of the PV plant shall be within the range of 0.59 leading to 0.95 lagging.
error_info: 数字错误：超前侧限值0.95被译成0.59。

source: 该批次风机共有200台，其中10台作为备件储备。
target: There are 200 wind turbines in this batch, one of which is reserved as a spare.
error_info: 数字错误：备件数量10台被译成1台。
